name: ghoul
lore:
Ghouls are the stuff of nightmares, born from the unholy hunger for humanoid flesh. Imagine the battlefield after the clash of armies, the air thick with the stench of death and decay. It is here, under the pale gaze of the moon, that ghouls emerge from their shallow graves, driven by an insatiable craving that dominates their wretched existence. They are the scavengers of the macabre, their emaciated forms a grotesque parody of life. The ghouls' eyes burn with a chilling intensity, reflecting the eternal hunger that gnaws at their very being.

These undead horrors are not mere beasts; they possess a cunning born of desperation. They lurk in the shadows of graveyards, their sharp teeth and filthy claws ever ready to tear into the flesh of the living. The ghoul's touch brings not only physical harm but also a terrible sickness known as ghoul fever, which can transform the victim into one of them. The existence of a ghoul is one of endless hunger, devoid of compassion or remorse, a chilling reminder of the depths to which the mortal form can be corrupted.
